name: codex-reasoning-sidebar
description: A local Codex plugin that streams the current window's reasoning chain into the in-app browser side panel with typing-style display.

interface.shortDescription: 实时显示当前 Codex 窗口的思维链
interface.longDescription: 在 Codex 内置浏览器侧边栏实时流式显示当前窗口的思考过程，自动跟随最近活动的会话，支持过滤和暂停。
